title: Release lore 0.8.0: version bump, CHANGELOG, README version lines, tag
description:
Cut 0.8.0 from dev. Dispatched by opum-agent under OPAG-248 (operator goal: resolve open lore-cli and quest-cli issues and release the updated pair). The six pre-release defects are landed: LCLI-534, 535, 536, 512, 533, 522.

WHY 0.8.0 AND NOT 0.7.1, ratified by opum-agent: dev carries a NEW COMMAND (lore types, LCLI-537), a NEW CONFIG KEY (profile.strict_types, LCLI-538) and a NEW FAILURE MODE in a shipped gate (committed-schema drift detection in lore check, LCLI-539). Minor-bump shaped under 0.x.

THE PAIR IS NON-LOCKSTEP BY DECISION, not by drift. quest-cli ships 0.9.0 (their v0.8.0 tag is already pushed with dev past it, and they will not re-point a pushed tag). OPAG-142 already established lore 0.7.0 + quest 0.7.1 as a QUALIFIED non-lockstep pair, so 'release the pair' means released TOGETHER, not numbered alike. Do not pin a version comparison anywhere to decide compatibility -- detect by presence.

PUBLICATION IS NOT PART OF THIS TASK. LCLI-482 is open and unresolved: OIDC trusted publishing cannot authenticate for this repository (GitHub issues immutable-format subject claims for repos recreated after 2026-07-15; lore-cli was recreated 2026-09-10; npm Trusted Publishing matches the classic form and returns E404). The only working path is scripts/publish-release.sh, which requires a human at a TTY for npm's browser OTP. Publication is also tier 3 and goes to this session's own user directly, never on an orchestrator's say-so.

COUPLINGS TO HONOUR AT TAG TIME:
- opum-marketplace federates skills/ BY TAG. Send them the tag name, tag object SHA, the commit it peels to, and the resolved skills/ tree SHA, then a second message when npm actually publishes (LCLI-469). Their check does not go red when we tag -- it re-resolves an immutable pinned ref -- so this is bookkeeping, not an incident.
- opum-cli-e2e needs the six per-platform ladybug-package-qualification-<platform> artifacts for its --lore-report rows. These come from a release.yml workflow_dispatch with publish:false (a build, no registry action), NOT from the tag: release.yml has no tag trigger.
- The new lore check drift gate is a fleet compatibility event. Sibling repos pin lore by hand in their own workflows, so it reaches them only when they bump that line; the heads-up goes out with the pin move.
